welcome:
Welcome to the Vim CLI Playground.
Type commands to explore a simulated Vim editing environment.
Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

steps.instruction: Open the Nginx configuration file for editing.
Jump to the end of the file to see the last settings.
Now jump back to the top of the file.
Replace 'auto' with '4' on the current line.
Turn on line numbers to see where you are.
Replace all occurrences of 'listen 80' with 'listen 8080' across the entire file.
Save the file and quit Vim.
Open three configuration files at once using Vim.
List all open buffers to see the loaded files.
Start recording a macro into register 'a' that will add a comment header to the file.
steps.hint: Try: qa (start recording into register a)

steps.instruction: Go to the top of the file, open a new line above, and type a comment header. Then stop recording.
Play the macro stored in register 'a' to apply the same header.
Switch to the last buffer (cache.conf) and apply the macro again.
Save all open buffers and quit.

commands.help:
Available commands:
  vim <file>                — Open file for editing
  :w                       — Save (write) current file
  :q                       — Quit (fails if unsaved changes)
  :wq                      — Save and quit
  :q!                      — Quit without saving
  :e <file>                — Open another file
  :vs                      — Vertical split
  :sp                      — Horizontal split
  :tabnew                  — Open new tab
  :bn / :bp                — Next/previous buffer
  :buffers                 — List open buffers
  /pattern                 — Search forward
  ?pattern                 — Search backward
  :s/old/new/g             — Replace on current line
  :%s/old/new/g            — Replace in entire file
  dd / yy / p              — Delete/yank/paste line
  u / Ctrl+r               — Undo/redo
  qa / @a                  — Record/play macro
  :help                    — Open Vim help

  scenario                 — Start a guided lab
  clear                    — Clear the terminal
  help                     — Show this help
